title: Hybrid Opportunity as a Cybersecurity Delivery Coordinator
description:
Project context
The Cyber Delivery Coordinator is responsible for supporting the end-to-end delivery and operational governance of cybersecurity and IAM services provided by external vendors and internal teams. This role ensures service quality, contractual compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across Security and IAM services.
Goals and deliverables
Key Responsibilities
Multi-vendor & Contract Management
• Coordinate and align multiple external service providers involved in Security and IAM services.
• Monitor vendor performance against contractual commitments, SLAs, and KPIs.
• Identify service gaps, overlaps, risks, and dependencies across providers and drive corrective actions with the service owner and internal teams.
• Support contract lifecycle activities, including contract preparation renewals, service transitions, and onboarding of new providers.
Services Governance
• Support the governance of cybersecurity services delivered by external providers (MSSP, IAM vendors, integrators).
• Monitor daily vendor activities (monitoring, detection, incident response) to make sure they are in line with agreed SLAs, KPIs, and security requirements.
• Coordinate service reviews, operational committees, and steering committees with vendors
Cybersecurity & IAM Oversight
• Provide oversight of IAM services including Identity Governance, Access Management, PAM, MFA, and SSO.
• Ensure IAM services are aligned with internal security policies, compliance requirements, and business needs.
• Validate operational deliverables (SOP, ITSM workflows, and service catalog) from service providers.
Delivery, Risk and communication
• Support planning and coordination of cyber initiatives impacting SOC and IAM services.
• Participate in major incident management to ensure communication
• Track risks, issues, and dependencies, and escalate when necessary.
• Audit SPOC and actions follow-up
Stakeholder Management
• Interface with internal stakeholders: CISO office, IT infrastructure operations, and business teams.
• Provide clear reporting on service performance, risks, and improvement plans to senior management.
• Act as a trusted operational partner for internal teams on cybersecurity service topics.
Continuous Improvement & Transformation
• Contributes to the evolution of the SOC and IAM operating model.
• Identify opportunities to optimize service and processes quality, efficiency, and cost.
Cybersecurity & Technical Skills
• Strong understanding of SOC operations, incident management, and threat monitoring.
• Solid expertise in IAM domains (IGA, PAM, Access Management, MFA, SSO).
• Knowledge of hybrid and cloud security environments.
• Familiarity with cybersecurity standards and regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).

You’ll work with a group focused on driving systemization and innovation for next-generation Radio Access Network products, emphasizing baseband algorithms and the development of cutting-edge wireless technologies, including signal processing and multi-antenna systems.

Design, optimize, and validate physical layer (L1) and radio resource management (RRM) algorithms, focusing on digital signal processing, MIMO, and beamforming strategies.

The skills you bring:
10+ years of experience in wireless systems engineering, focusing on 5G/6G and RAN systemization with demonstrated technical direction and strategic alignment experience.
Deep expertise in communications theory, digital signal processing, MIMO, and beamforming techniques.
Strong experience with simulation environments and tools for link- and network-level evaluation.
Proven analytical, problem-solving, and innovation-driven mindset with a track record of delivering system-level improvements that positively impact product KPIs.
Demonstrated leadership, mentorship, and ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

title: Cybersecurity & Compliance Specialist
description:
Senior Cybersecurity & Compliance Specialist
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Cybersecurity & Compliance Specialist to help strengthen and continuously improve our organization's cybersecurity posture.
This role combines hands-on cybersecurity, risk management, compliance, and stakeholder engagement. You will work closely with IT teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure security controls are effective, compliant, and aligned with business needs.
You'll have a real impact on shaping security processes, assessing new technologies, managing cyber risk, and supporting regulatory compliance initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and enhance the organization's IT security architecture.
Manage security risks, maintain the IT risk register, and provide recommendations to leadership.
Coordinate and support security incident response, including critical incidents and post-incident reporting.
Lead vulnerability management activities, including risk assessment and remediation oversight.
Develop, review, and implement security policies, procedures, and standards.
Support access management processes, including oversight of Active Directory, privileged accounts, and MFA controls.
Assess the security of new systems, applications, and technology changes.
Prepare regular and ad hoc cybersecurity reports for management.
Deliver security awareness training and educational initiatives.
Collaborate with external partners, CSIRTs, regulators, and cybersecurity institutions.
Support business continuity activities and the continuous improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
What We're Looking For
Must-have:
Several years of experience in IT Security, Cybersecurity, or Security Compliance.
Practical experience in security risk management and incident handling.
Knowledge of vulnerability management processes.
Familiarity with cybersecurity regulations, including UKSC, NIS2, and GDPR.
Knowledge of security standards such as ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 22301.
Experience with access and identity management in Active Directory environments.
Ability to create security documentation, policies, analyses, and management reports.
Strong analytical thinking and risk assessment skills.
Ability to independently drive initiatives from identification to implementation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Nice to have:
Experience with S46, CSIRT/NASK, and UKSC/NIS2 reporting obligations.
Knowledge of NIST, CIS Controls, OWASP, and MITRE ATT&CK.
Experience with security and compliance audits.
Experience developing or improving an ISMS.
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or Lead Implementer.
Familiarity with SIEM, EDR/XDR, Vulnerability Management, and DLP solutions.
What We Offer
The opportunity to shape cybersecurity strategy and security maturity across the organization.
A high level of ownership, autonomy, and impact.
Participation in cybersecurity, compliance, and IT transformation initiatives.
Close collaboration with IT, business teams, and senior leadership.
Professional development opportunities, including support for certifications and continuous learning.
Exposure to real-world cybersecurity and risk management challenges.

Szukamy osoby z doświadczeniem w Data Governance, Data Management lub Data Quality, która będzie odpowiedzialna za rozwój zasad zarządzania danymi, współpracę z biznesem i IT oraz monitorowanie jakości danych.

zarządzania metadanymi,

Praktyczna znajomość SQL.

Certyfikaty lub dodatkowe wykształcenie z zakresu Data Governance i Data Management.

Pracę przy rozwoju obszaru Data Governance w dużej organizacji.

Możliwość wpływania na standardy i sposób zarządzania danymi w organizacji.
Udział w projektach związanych z jakością, bezpieczeństwem i wykorzystaniem danych.
